title: Townsen Brown at Caltech in the 1920s, discovering thrust from asymmetric capacitors
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Townsen Brown at Caltech in the 1920s, discovering thrust from asymmetric capacitors, about 1920s at Caltech, Pasadena, California, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: But what most people don't know is that a decade before Jack Parsons in the 1920s, there was someone else at Caltech with some very different ideas for deep space travel.
